target_unit: prespecified taxon x site x season unit
repeat_definition: A fresh estimate of the same final dependency estimand from a non-overlapping independent plant panel, using the same protocol and a distinct frozen source bundle.

minimum_for_calibration_scope_reliabilit.note: These are mathematical estimability minima for a variance-component reliability calculation, not a confirmatory sample-size recommendation.

pilot_replacement_scope.between_plant_variance: pilot-estimable after admission and sufficient independent plants
pilot_replacement_scope.coverage: pilot-summarizable but not automatically equal to cross-lineage design coverage
pilot_replacement_scope.direct_dependency_reliability: not identified by the ordinary single pilot panel

technical_recount_boundary: Blinded recounts of the same preserved SVD sample identify pollen-count technical repeatability only and cannot open this final-estimand reliability gate.
forbidden_substitutions: between-plant biological dispersion from one unrepeated target panel

dependency_fdq_design_injection.reopen_rule: First identify calibration-scope reliability from independent repeated final-estimand panels, then separately review whether that reliability is transportable to the prespecified cross-lineage taxon x site x season predictor.

claim_boundary: This gate prevents technical repeatability, biological subsampling variation or synthetic sensitivity values from being relabelled as reliability of the final direct-dependency predictor. It does not identify historical Bombus causation, empirical dependency x FDQ moderation or causal island-boundary effects.
